description: Numerical realisation of the descent involution tau_hat_0 = ell_0 . d_1 acting on End_C(A_1) at A=1 (proton scale).  A_0 = H_3(q_0); Omega^1 = ker(m); A_1 = A_0 (x) Omega^1.  Phase A.3 of issue #522.

construction.A0_basis: H_3(q_0) on the 6 reduced words of S_3.
construction.connection_choice: Trivial / universal derivation d(a) = 1 (x) a - a (x) 1; ell_0(a) := a (x) d(sigma_1) (sigma_1 = e_1, generator).
construction.descent_phi0: phi_0 chosen as the dual functional to d(sigma_1) within Omega^1, normalised so that phi_0(d(sigma_1)) = 1.  This is the splitting condition d_1 . ell_0 = id_{A_0}.
construction.tau_hat_0_form: P := L0 R1 (180 x 180 rank-6 idempotent).  tau_hat_0(phi) = P phi P, hence tau_hat_0 = P (x) P on End(A_1) ~= A_1 (x) A_1^*.

math_gaps: ell_0 / d_1 are not uniquely specified by the content blocks: the descent-lemma-proof.md describes an object-level Frobenius restriction r_n = epsilon (x) id, but Omega^1 has no canonical unit element (the universal Kahler differential is split-exact but not as a unital A-bimodule).  Realising (ell_0, d_1) requires a chosen connection nabla : A_0 -> Omega^1.  This witness uses the trivial / universal connection.
